  "biography": "From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia\n\nDuke Moore, (July 15, 1913 as James Moore – November 16, 1976), is an American actor who has the distinction of spending his entire on-screen career in productions by Edward D. Wood, Jr..\n\nBetween 1953 and 1970, Moore appeared in the following for Wood:\n\n    Crossroads of Laredo\n\n    Final Curtain\n\n    Night of the Ghouls\n\n    Plan 9 from Outer Space\n\n    The Sinister Urge\n\n    Take it Out in Trade\n\nDuke Moore appeared in more Wood films than any other member of Ed's entourage.\n\nMoore also received a posthumous addition to his oeuvre when outtake footage to Take it out in Trade was found in a projectionist's booth in a pornographic theater in California and subsequently released on video in \"as is\" form. This footage can be seen in Take it Out in Trade: The Outtakes.\n\nDuke died in Hollywood of a heart attack.\n\nDescription above from the Wikipedia article Duke Moore, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.",
